tagline: School management for Pakistan, built for many schools on one platform.

home.body: Each school is an isolated tenant. Greenwood never sees City Model data. You run the platform as Super Admin.

common.name: Name
common.emptyHint: Add a record to get started.

auth.headline: One platform. Every school keeps its own data.
auth.body: Attendance, fees, exams, payroll, and parent updates — in English and Urdu.
auth.footer: Built for multi-campus schools across Pakistan.

fees.title: Fees
fees.body: Monthly challans in PKR, JazzCash ready.

exams.title: Exams
exams.body: Marks, grades, and bilingual report cards.

login.title: Sign in to Taleem
login.superHint: Sign in with your school account. Platform owners can leave the subdomain empty.
login.schoolHint: Use the admin email and password created for this school.
login.invalid: Email, password, or school subdomain is wrong.
login.resetOk: Password updated. Sign in with the new password.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.lead: Enter the email used for this school. We will create a reset link.
forgotPassword.sent: If that account exists, a reset link is ready.
forgotPassword.localLink: Email is not wired yet, so the reset link is shown here.
forgotPassword.failed: Could not start a password reset

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetPassword.missing: This reset link is missing or incomplete.

onboarding.title: Create your Taleem workspace
onboarding.lead: Name the school, pick a plan, then add the first admin.
onboarding.needSchool: Add the school name, subdomain, and a plan.

dashboard.upgradeBody: The {feature} module is not included in the {plan} plan.
dashboard.filtersHint: Narrow the charts by academic year, class, and date range.
dashboard.trendHint: Present + late as a percent of marks in the selected dates.
dashboard.trendEmpty: Mark attendance in this range to see the trend.
dashboard.mixHint: Marked days in the selected filters.
dashboard.mixEmpty: No attendance records in this range.
dashboard.genderHint: Enrollment for the selected year and class.
dashboard.genderEmpty: Admit students to see the gender mix.
dashboard.classEmpty: No enrolled students for these filters.
dashboard.invoiceHint: Fee invoices due in the selected dates.
dashboard.feesEmpty: No fee invoices to chart yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Upload a logo and write a header and footer. They appear in the app chrome and on certificates, receipts, and report cards.
settings.previewHint: This is how the school identity looks on documents.
settings.previewFooter: Footer text will appear here on every printed page.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP · 1 MB max. Used in the sidebar, header, and certificates.
settings.headerFooterHint: Shown on every school page and on printed certificates.
settings.savedTexts: Header and footer saved. They now appear across the app and on certificates.
settings.savedLogo: School logo updated. It now shows in the sidebar, header, and printed documents.

setup.title: School setup
setup.lead: Academic years, classes, sections, and subjects for this school only.
setup.subject: Subject

students.title: Students
students.lead: Admissions, search, filters, and CSV import. Soft-delete keeps history.
students.emptyHint: Admit a student or import a CSV. Add classes first in School setup if the list is empty.

staffPage.title: Staff
staffPage.lead: Teachers and office staff. Soft-delete keeps history. Payroll is a separate module.
staffPage.emptyHint: Add teachers and office staff here.

attendancePage.title: Attendance
attendancePage.lead: Mark a section, see the class summary, and send WhatsApp absence alerts.
attendancePage.emptySetup: Add a class, section, and students in School setup first.

feesPage.title: Fees
feesPage.lead: Monthly invoices are created automatically (due the 10th by default). JazzCash / EasyPaisa, dues, receipts, and reminders stay on this page.
feesPage.manualHint: Use this for quarterly / one-time fees, or to backfill another month. Monthly tuition is billed automatically.
feesPage.emptyStructures: Add a fee structure to start billing.

payrollPage.title: Payroll
payrollPage.lead: Monthly salaries in integer paisa. Generate a run, then mark cash or bank paid.

timetablePage.title: Timetable
timetablePage.lead: Weekly periods per section. Teachers see the same grid.

examsPage.title: Exams
examsPage.lead: Marks entry, Pakistan letter grades, bilingual report cards.

announcementsPage.title: Announcements
announcementsPage.lead: School notices. Broadcast uses the same WhatsApp/SMS notification interface.
announcementsPage.emptyHint: Post a notice for staff, parents, or students.

socialPostsPage.title: Social posts
socialPostsPage.lead: Draft captions for Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, YouTube, TikTok, and X. Copy the text, post it on the network, then mark it published here.
socialPostsPage.caption: Caption
socialPostsPage.imageHint: Up to 10 PNG, JPEG, or WebP files.
socialPostsPage.tooManyImages: You can attach at most 10 images.
socialPostsPage.captionHint: Write the caption you will paste on social media.
socialPostsPage.empty: No posts in this filter yet.

certificatesPage.title: Certificates
certificatesPage.lead: Bonafide, character, and leaving certificates use your school logo, header, and footer from Settings.

portalPage.title: My portal
portalPage.lead: Attendance, dues, and exam results for linked students.

reportsPage.title: Reports
reportsPage.lead: Live totals for {school}. Super Admin sees the same metrics across all tenants.

superAdmin.title: Tenants
superAdmin.lead: All schools on this platform. Suspend or activate without touching tenant data.
superAdmin.reportsLead: Aggregated enrollment, attendance, and fee collection across tenants.
superAdmin.billingLead: SaaS invoices to schools. Separate from student JazzCash/EasyPaisa fees.
